name: request-40mib-one-image
rule: Spec 050 §1.4 P1 exit (049 §7.4): sizes are synthetic. A request with one inline base64 image is split (the part is extracted, the text stays in the skeleton) and reassembles to source_sha256; a side above max_retain_bytes is truncated(body_cap). The bytes are rebuilt from the recipe: the JSON template with '@IMAGE@' replaced by image_base64_length copies of 'A', or a response of side_bytes copies of 'x' inside a JSON string.
